name: cck-sis
description: CCK Student Information System on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute cck-sis-db --remote --file=private/seed-public.sql && wrangler d1 execute cck-sis-db --remote --file=private/seed-private.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute cck-sis-db --local --file=private/seed-public.sql && wrangler d1 execute cck-sis-db --local --file=private/seed-private.sql
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:html && npm run scan:secrets && npm audit --omit=dev && npm test
